item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an easterly airstream will also affect the coast of southeastern China. Besides, a broad area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central to northern parts of the South China Sea next week. The northeast monsoon will reach southern China in the latter part of next week. There will be a few showers over the region.
